name: @workspace.sh/table-gtk
description: The .table views for GTK4 and libadwaita, through GTKX: the same views and props as table-ui, drawn as GTK widgets.

@gtkx/css.comment: Optional only so `npm install` at the repo root (on a Mac, say) doesn't fetch GTK bindings. A GTK app that renders these views has them.

comment: Typechecked and tested by apps/linux, which has GTKX and this machine's generated bindings; nothing here can check GTK code on its own.
